name: Journey Diary Import
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Keeps escaped tag text as text.
Plans large photo backups without a slow scan.
changes_user: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
Entry text that shows an HTML tag, such as , now stays text in the note.
The import preview of a backup with many photos no longer freezes.
tip: Set the note folder to your daily note folder and turn on Merge by date to append entries.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Journey Diary Import is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for moving your diary into Obsidian with it.
